instructions: Commit and push any code changes.

Set `$DISMISS_MESSAGE` to one sentence on what changed and run, even if no code changed: `pr-shepherd apply review https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 --transport rest --reply-thread-ids PRRT_thrash_84 --message "$DISMISS_MESSAGE" --adopt-existing-replies --dismiss-review-ids PRR_bot_overdue_84 --require-sha "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"`
